edits.new_text:
-- Refuse all native scrolling if any called routine differs from this build.
    -- Build 26088801 keeps some game.dll code pages unreadable until the game first runs them: a routine
    -- whose bytes cannot be read yet is checked again right before its first call (native.lua,
    -- routines_ready) and never called unchecked; bytes that read and differ refuse everything.
    local game = api.module('game.dll')
    if not game then return nil, 'unsupported native scroll routine' end
    local pending = {}
    for _, entry in ipairs(module.native_signatures) do
        local bytes = entry[2]:gsub('..', function(hex) return string.char(tonumber(hex, 16)) end)
        local now = api.read(game + entry[1], #bytes)
        if now == nil then
            pending[entry[1]] = bytes
        elseif now ~= bytes then
            return nil, 'unsupported native scroll routine'
        end
    end
    api.pending_signatures = pending
    return api

edits.new_text:
-- The game routines each route calls. One whose code page was not readable when native_api checked it is
-- checked here, through the reader, right before its first call; while it still cannot be read nothing
-- is called, and bytes that differ refuse. Once all are checked this reads nothing.
local ROUTE_ROUTINES = {grid = {ANIMATION_STOP, SCROLL_SET, GRID_SOLVER}, career = {POSITION_SET},
                        bindings = {SCROLL_SET, POSITION_SET}, settings = {SCROLL_SET, POSITION_SET},
                        input = {INPUT_CONSUME}}
local function routines_ready(bridge, which)
    local api = bridge.api
    local pending = type(api) == 'table' and api.pending_signatures
    if not pending or next(pending) == nil then return true end
    local list = ROUTE_ROUTINES[which] or ROUTE_ROUTINES.grid
    for index = 1, #list do
        local rva = list[index]
        local bytes = pending[rva]
        if bytes then
            local now = api.read(bridge.game + rva, #bytes)
            if now == nil then return false end
            if now ~= bytes then error('unsupported native scroll routine', 0) end
            pending[rva] = nil
        end
    end
    return true
end

-- Runs under pcall in native_apply (a named function, so no closure per drag frame).
local function apply_native(bridge, model, value, calls)
    if not routines_ready(bridge, bridge.route) then error('native routine not resident yet', 0) end
    calls = calls or owner_calls(bridge)
